$description: Kiwi UI design tokens — Ruled Folio. One DTCG source (W3C Design Tokens format, stable Oct 2025) in three tiers: global (the locked block of kiwi-ui/DESIGN.md), semantic (roles; palette.mjs aliases carried by reference + Phase 3 additions), component (one group per shared component, eight states each). Modes: $value is light / comfortable; $extensions.mode.dark and .compact carry the overrides (two orthogonal axes). Spec: kiwi-ui/DESIGN.md § Design system. Check: .design-foundations/tokens/check-tokens.mjs. Emit: build-tokens.mjs.

org.kiwi.deprecationPolicy: A deprecated name keeps a safe value and is removed no earlier than two MAJOR versions after the release that deprecated it, and no earlier than six months after that release, whichever is later; the checker asserts the removal major.

.kiwi-bg-secondary.note: one accent hue; the pink secondary is retired

.kiwi-spinner.note: progress is neutral text with the text dots, never a spinner

@keyframes kiwi-spin.note: no spinning glyph in the motion budget

.kiwi-step-connector.note: restyled: a neutral hairline; [data-done] marks the span up to the current step

.kiwi-step-pending.note: a pending step is the indicator's default: hairline boundary, secondary text

.kiwi-step-active.note: the current step is state by attribute, not by class; selection tint, no glow

.kiwi-step-completed.note: a completed step: the success surface with the check glyph (status = surface + icon)

.kiwi-step-error.note: a failed step: the error surface with the cross glyph

.kiwi-step-connector-active.note: the connector has one neutral emphasis, not a brand fill

.kiwi-progress-dots.note: progress is neutral text with the text dots (G9); stages that finished or failed are status chips (.kiwi-chip-status-*)

.kiwi-progress-dot-active.note: no pulsing dot: the text dots carry the motion

.kiwi-progress-dot-completed.note: a finished stage is a success status chip

.kiwi-progress-dot-error.note: a failed stage is an error status chip

.kiwi-progress-bar.note: restyled: the neutral determinate bar, --kiwi-border-interactive on --kiwi-bg-hover

.kiwi-progress-bar-indeterminate.note: an indeterminate sweep is outside the motion budget; a determinate .kiwi-progress-bar stays

@keyframes kiwi-pulse.note: no pulsing in the motion budget

@keyframes kiwi-progress-indeterminate.note: no sweeping gradient in the motion budget

.kiwi-help.note: the reason or helper line under a control, linked by aria-describedby; data-state="error" or "success" takes the status text colour

org.kiwi.literalPolicy: Colour literals: hex only in global.*; semantic.color.logo.* (G2) and semantic.color.on-paper.* (G5, mode-frozen) are the only colour literals outside it; backdrop and shadow.* reference --shadow-ink and carry their alphas in $extensions["org.kiwi"].alpha, composed by the emitter. Component tier: every value is a reference to the semantic tier except a literal marked $extensions["org.kiwi"].literal with its reason (component-specific geometry: the checker lists the marked ones and fails on any other). Forms the guard catches outside the source: hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), hwb(), oklch()/oklab(), lab()/lch(), color(), color-mix(), light-dark(), named colours other than transparent, currentColor and inherit, palette-object imports, and the MUI palette paths that bypass the roles: the strings "grey.NN" and "common.white" / "common.black", and the accesses theme.palette.grey[...] / palette.grey.NN and palette.common.* (common allowed in src/components/Brand/InstitutionLogo.tsx only, G2); the scan covers src/** outside src/services/, index.html, public/*.webmanifest, public/**/*.svg (the mascot artwork allowlisted) and .storybook/**.

interimChart.note: Interim until Phase 6 registers chart.* (five categorical series per mode, hue-separated and colour-blind-checked). The -11 steps (and accent-12) clear 3:1 on --surface in both modes (asserted by check-tokens.mjs § 16), so the stand-ins meet the brief's release gate for chart marks even before Phase 6. Theme.ts declares Palette.chart.series1-5 and StandaloneUserActivity, StandaloneDailySessions, StandaloneUserEngine, StandaloneTopActions, StandaloneUserDuration and Theme.test.ts read them, so the theme swap keeps the keys with these no-purple stand-ins from the locked ramps (no red in analytical views) and Theme.test.ts expects these values until Phase 6 replaces them.

reserved.chart.*: Phase 6 registers the chart tokens here (five categorical series per mode, ≥3:1 on the plot background); until then the MUI theme keeps palette.chart with the interimChart stand-ins.
reserved.companion.*: Phase 4 registers companion.slot.* and companion.backing here.

--kiwi-secondary.note: Kiwi has one accent hue; the pink secondary is retired

--kiwi-gray-900.note: MD grey mapped to the nearest cream/tan neutral

--kiwi-bg-selected-hover.note: a selected row does not change on hover

--kiwi-text-disabled.note: disabled labels are secondary text on the disabled surface

--kiwi-border-default.note: decorative hairline; not a control boundary

--kiwi-font-family.note: Source Sans 3 + the CJK stack; self-host @fontsource-variable/source-sans-3

--kiwi-letter-spacing-wide.note: no tracked-out labels, no CSS capitals

--kiwi-radius-md.note: no more than two sizes of radius; both are 2 px

--kiwi-transition-slow.note: orchestration is not part of the budget

--kiwi-editor-bg.note: code follows the mode (light here); no more VS Code dark

--kiwi-size-control.note: button and input height (comfortable: Kiwi Apps are student-facing)

global.$description: Tier 1. The locked block of kiwi-ui/DESIGN.md, verbatim: three recorded palette.mjs runs (A seed 156 muted, B seed 95 muted, C seed 156 balanced), the type scale, the space scale, radii and the motion budget. Values change only by re-running palette.mjs and re-confirming the lock.

color.$description: Ramps: step 9 is the hue's chroma cusp (the solid), so 8 → 9 → 10 is not monotonic; roles never read a ramp by position. --neutral-9/10 are not published as role tokens.

neutral.$description: run B · seed 95 muted · cream/tan-tinted neutrals

accent.$description: run A · seed 156 muted · forest/sage accent

paper.$description: run B · accent steps 1–4 · the canvas ramp

error.$description: run C · seed 156 balanced

success.$description: run C · seed 156 balanced

green-black.$description: run A's --accent-on-solid literal: the darkest green-black the runs produce (C 0.020). Not emitted as a property of its own; the lock writes it inline as the dark --accent-on-solid and --shadow-ink.

ui.$description: One humanist sans for display and body (G6, G15) with the G7 CJK stack; self-hosted from @fontsource-variable/source-sans-3.

wordmark.$description: Montserrat 800 italic, only inside KiwiWordmark (G6). Not a UI face; listed so the lint can allow it in one component.

type.$description: DESIGN.md · Type › Scale (rem at a 16 px root) and leading in px

semibold.$description: Headings, labels, selected items, CJK emphasis (upright). 700 is unused.

space.$description: DESIGN.md · Space, shape, depth: the 4 px scale. Density changes the step a role uses, never the scale.

standard.$description: menus, popovers, the chat panel, dialogs, toasts entering

shimmer.$description: the skeleton sweep, the one permitted moving gradient

semantic.$description: Tier 2. Roles. Colour aliases (carried + additions), editor/syntax/console roles, shadows, density deltas (space, size, type), motion, layers.

color.$description: The palette.mjs semantic aliases of the locked block, carried as references so they stay identical by construction (per-mode overrides as locked), then the additions registered by Phase 3. CSS names of the carried aliases are the locked names.

background.$description: Canvas (page). Locked override: the cream canvas / the warm dark canvas.

surface.$description: Sheet (panels, dialogs, inputs, the chat panel): always the lighter step.

surface-hover.$description: Hover rows and controls; tonal, instant.

surface-active.$description: Pressed rows, role chips, disabled fills, the in-progress surface.

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text, chrome icons at rest, disabled labels.

accent-bg-subtle.$description: Selection and current-item tint; tertiary hover.

accent-bg-subtle-active.$description: The pressed tint of secondary and tertiary controls: accent-4, one step past the accent-3 hover tint (the functional ramps have no fourth step, so the outlined destructive keeps error-3 and the scale on press).

accent-solid.$description: The one filled control per region: forest in light (accent-9 is 1.70:1 on the canvas), sage in dark.

accent-solid-active.$description: The pressed fill of a filled control: one step beyond hover, away from the surface, so pressed is told from hovered by its fill and not by the 0.98 scale alone. Light presses to the system's green-black (the darkest value in the system, the lock's dark --accent-on-solid), beyond the accent-11 hover; dark presses to accent-12, the lightest accent step, beyond the accent-10 hover (1.30:1 against it) and away from the dark surface, with --accent-on-solid at 15.9:1 on it.

accent-on-solid.$description: The label on the filled control.

accent-text.$description: Links (underlined), accent text and icons, secondary/tertiary button labels.

border-interactive.$description: The ≥3:1 boundary of every control identified by a border: inputs, unchecked controls, unselected filter chips, grips.

focus-ring.$description: 2 px solid, 2 px offset, :focus-visible; never removed, never animated.

shadow-ink.$description: The hue-shifted shadow colour; shadows are precomputed rgba() of it.

link.$description: Links in prose and chrome; always underlined in prose (WCAG 1.4.1).

selection.$description: The lock's selection rule: tint + accent text + a 2 px solid marker. Also the on/checked state of switches, checkboxes and radios. Under forced-colors: active a box-shadow computes to none, so every marker selector also draws the marker as a 2 px Highlight outline (outline-offset −2 px) inside @media (forced-colors: active), and the dots, dash and thumb that are backgrounds take CanvasText there; glyph, weight and position cues survive as system colours.

destructive.$description: Destructive controls are outlined, never filled (D4): error-11 boundary and label, error-3 hover tint.

status.$description: Status surfaces (G1): -3 surface, -11 text and shape icon, -9 only as a dot or small fill beside a label.

in-progress.$description: In progress is neutral (G1, TD-29): surface-active + text-secondary + the static dashed-ring icon; the moving part is the text dots.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls: fill, label and hairline. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3/1.4.11 but kept ≥4.5 where a label is read; every disabled control states why (helper text or a toggletip on the aria-disabled control itself).

icon.$description: Disabled icon-only controls (no fill to distinguish them).

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholders; the shimmer highlight is the one permitted moving gradient.

icon.$description: Icons are currentColor; these are the resting colours in chrome.

paper-frame.$description: The neutral frame around paper (PDF pages, email previews, app iframes): never the accent (G5, TD-08).

fill-none.$description: The transparent fill of text-only and canvas-level components (tertiary buttons, icon buttons, tabs, rows, the empty frame, the tutor row): a role, so the component tier carries no literal.

backdrop.$description: Dialog and modal backdrops: --shadow-ink at 40 % (light) / 60 % (dark). The colour is a reference; the alphas live in $extensions["org.kiwi"].alpha and the emitter composes the rgba() per mode, so a change of ink cannot drift it. Never a grey wash, no blur. Declared per mode because it depends on a mode token.

logo.$description: Institution logos are neutral black or white by surface, never the accent, never the tinted ink (G2). The one permitted pure black / pure white.

on-light.$description: On light surfaces, in either mode.

on-dark.$description: On dark surfaces, in either mode.

on-paper.$description: Marks drawn on the white PDF page. The page keeps its own rendering in dark mode (G5), so these never follow the mode: light-ramp values frozen as literals, the allowlisted exception beside backdrop, shadows and the G2 logo. The pin, chunk and wash literals name their light source in $extensions["org.kiwi"].frozen and check-tokens.mjs asserts they still equal it, so a palette.mjs re-run cannot leave them behind.

page.$description: The paper itself: react-pdf renders on white. Content, not a UI colour (the lock's no-pure-white rule is about UI surfaces).

pin.$description: Comment pins visible to students, the hidden pin's ring and the selected chunk: light --accent-12 frozen; 13.9:1 on the page in both modes.

chunk.$description: Chunk boxes and the drag box (A-24): light --neutral-11 frozen; 6.2:1 on the page.

editor.$description: Code editors, code blocks and consoles follow the mode; they are not paper (G5). One role set drives the Ace themes, the Prism style object and the console. The editable editor is a control (its host carries --editor-border-editable); read-only viewers and the console are sheets with the --editor-border hairline.

selection.$description: The text selection in the editor: a tint stronger than the active line's step would allow the syntax colours (light: accent-4 at 1.15:1 on --editor-bg; accent-5 would drop strings to 4.41:1) and, in dark, accent-6 at 1.47:1 on --editor-bg (every syntax colour at least 5.17:1 on it); drawn with the 1 px --editor-selection-outline so the selection reads against the surface and the active line by its edge, never by the tint alone.

selection-outline.$description: The 1 px outline of the text selection (outline-offset −1 px, inside the selection box): --selection-marker, 12.7:1 light / 8.3:1 dark against --editor-bg and ≥ 3:1 against the active line, so a selection on the active line is still visible.

border.$description: The hairline of read-only code surfaces (ReadOnlyCodeViewer, the console): decorative, not a control boundary.

border-editable.$description: The editable editor's host boundary: a control identified by its border, so it is --border-interactive (≥ 3:1 on the canvas and the surface), like a field; read-only viewers keep --editor-border.

block-rule.$description: The 2 px left rule of a code block inside a message (no box, no nested card).

inline-bg.$description: Inline code background inside prose: one tonal step.

syntax.$description: Low-chroma, weight-led syntax roles (D7): keywords by weight, strings in the accent, numbers in info, diagnostics in error/warning. Two hues in code so status stays status.

error.$description: wavy underline

1.$description: menus, popovers, the slash-command menu, tooltips, toasts: --shadow-ink at 14 %

2.$description: the chat panel in modal and side modes, dialogs, the floating launcher: --shadow-ink at 8 % and 26 %

shadow.$description: DESIGN.md depth order: tonal step → hairline → shadow. Two depths, two alphas, composed from --shadow-ink at build time (color-mix with transparent at p % equals the ink at alpha p). Declared per mode because they depend on a mode token.

space.$description: Density deltas (DW-3.9): the step a role uses, comfortable → compact. Comfortable: student, auth and reading surfaces. Compact: /admin/* and tool chrome.

inline.$description: Gap between controls in a row: 12 → 8

block.$description: Between blocks inside a message: 12 (fixed; reading rhythm)

reading-gutter.$description: Text distance from the ruler in single-column reading surfaces: 24 px. The narrow-viewport gutter is the lock's open question for Phase 7 (decided on the 390 × 844 renders as a container rule on the reading column), not a density delta and not implemented here.

icon-gap.$description: Between an icon and its label, and a chip's horizontal padding: 8 (fixed)

icon-row-gap.$description: The gap between icon buttons in a row (the chat header, the PDF bar, the pager): 4 with a fine pointer, 8 with a coarse one, so 36 px buttons sit on a 44 px pitch and their 44 px hit areas never overlap (the feedback toolbar does the same through its pitch role)

hit-row-gap.$description: The gap that opens between stacked 36 px rows on a coarse pointer so their 44 px hit areas do not overlap (the S-02 drawer's file rows): 0 with a fine pointer, 8 with a coarse one (36 + 8 = a 44 px pitch), the same move as --space-icon-row-gap for icon buttons

float-offset-x.$description: Toasts and the launcher from the side edge: 24 (fixed)

edge-margin.$description: Rail item margins and the launcher's minimum distance from the viewport edge: 8 (fixed)

frame-gap.$description: The empty frame: slot to line, copy to call to action: 24 (fixed; a reading surface)

line-gap.$description: The empty frame: line to copy: 8 (fixed)

control-pad-y.$description: Vertical padding inside a 44 / 36 px control around a 20 px label with the 1 px border: (control − 20 − 2) / 2 = 11 / 7. A density delta of the semantic tier; derived from --size-control, so a change of control height moves it here, once

field-pad-y.$description: Vertical padding inside a field around its 24 / 20 px control text with the 1 px border: (control − leading − 2) / 2 = 9 / 7

label-gap.$description: A field's label to its control, and the control to its helper: 8 (fixed)

popup-margin.$description: A floating popup's minimum distance from the viewport edge (menus, tooltips): 12 (fixed)

size.$description: Control geometry per density (DW-3.9). Fixed sizes carry no compact value.

control-icon.$description: Icon buttons (the top bar keeps 44 on both areas)

row.$description: Table and DataGrid rows and header (DataGrid standard / compact)

nav-item.$description: Sidebar item height (the sidebar is admin-only, so compact in practice)

icon-sm.$description: Icons inside chips, helper text and the feedback toolbar

menu-item.$description: Menu and listbox items; 44 on coarse pointers

target-min.$description: Minimum hit area on coarse pointers (student routes); extended with a pseudo-element, never by drawn height

top-bar.$description: The top bar on both areas

top-bar-button.$description: Top-bar icon buttons on both areas

avatar.$description: The tutor avatar (G9); other mascot slots are companion.slot.* (Phase 4)

child-dot.$description: The current child row's dot in the sidebar (a mark, not a control)

marker.$description: The selected row / current item inset edge

col-min-text.$description: Minimum text column (Slug, names; TD-39): the widest expected token + 2 × --space-cell-x

col-min-date.$description: A fixed-format date-time '2026-10-14 18:45' measures 113 px at 16 px and 99 px at 14 px; + 2 × --space-cell-x, rounded up to the 4 px scale

col-min-num.$description: Right-aligned tabular counts up to '16,384' (50 / 44 px) + padding

col-min-status.$description: The widest status chip ('Importing…' with its icon, 112 / 104 px) + padding, so a chip never truncates

col-min-check.$description: A checkbox cell: the 18 px box + 1.5 px borders + padding; nothing else in the cell

icon-fixed.$description: Glyphs that do not change with density: the launcher's chat glyph

toolbar-bar.$description: The PDF viewer toolbar: a 44 px bar on both areas (tool chrome holding 36 px buttons), like the 52 px top bar

hit-icon.$description: Hit area of an icon button: its drawn size with a fine pointer, 44 with a coarse one (extended by a pseudo-element, never the drawn size)

toolbar-button-sm.$description: The drawn feedback-toolbar button and its line: a 16 px glyph on a 28 px square, so the toolbar row ticks the ruler once

toolbar-divider.$description: The 1 px dividers between button groups in a toolbar (the PDF viewer bar)

hit-toolbar.$description: Hit area of a feedback-toolbar button: its drawn 28 px with a fine pointer, 44 with a coarse one

pitch-toolbar.$description: Centre-to-centre pitch of the feedback toolbar: 28 px buttons 2 px apart with a fine pointer; 44 with a coarse one (5 × 44 = 220 px fits the 420 px panel and a 390 px phone) while the glyph stays on the 28 px line

hit-chip.$description: Hit area of a filter chip; 44 on coarse pointers

hit-switch.$description: Hit area of a switch track; 44 on coarse pointers

hit-checkbox.$description: Hit area of a checkbox or radio; 44 on coarse pointers

hit-text-action.$description: Hit area of a text action (Retry, Dismiss, Undo, Read, Change range, a citation): its own 24 px line box with a fine pointer, 44 px on a coarse one, drawn by a centred pseudo-element that may overlap the surrounding prose

hit-control.$description: Hit area of a button or field: its drawn height (44 / 36) with a fine pointer, 44 with a coarse one, so compact tool chrome on student routes (the chat composer, the PDF bar's text buttons and page field, the search panel) reaches 44 px without changing its drawn size

hit-tab.$description: Hit area of a tab: its drawn height with a fine pointer, 44 with a coarse one (the file and output tab bars on S-03)

pin.$description: The comment pin disc on the paper (S-02, A-24)

hit-pin.$description: Hit area of a comment pin: its 24 px disc with a fine pointer, 44 px with a coarse one, through a centred pseudo-element (the pin is a mark on paper students open on phones)

kpi-min.$description: Minimum KPI tile width before the row wraps

badge.$description: The launcher's neutral count badge: a 20 px disc (--radius-round, one of the lock's three radii); counts above 9 read 9+ so the disc never becomes a pill

type.$description: Type roles per density: body and control text step down one size in compact; labels, captions and headings do not change.

body.$description: Reading and comfortable forms 16/24 (CJK-dominant blocks 28) → compact chrome 14/20

body-cjk.$description: CJK-dominant blocks: 1.75 leading (28 on 16; 24 on 14 in compact chrome, the nearest 4 px step to 24.5); decided per block

button.$description: Buttons at both densities (DESIGN.md Type table); height comes from inset padding

label.$description: Field labels, table headers, chip labels

caption.$description: Helper text, timestamps, session label, citations; sentence case, never CSS capitals

page-title.$description: H1 of admin and student pages, the empty-state line

section-title.$description: H2 in pages, panel and dialog titles

group-title.$description: Field-group headings, KPI labels at comfortable density

deck.$description: Lead paragraphs, the student's question in the panel

code.$description: Code blocks, editor, console: 14/24 so a code block ticks the ruler at 24

popup-supporting.$description: Small-popup contract: 12/16, the minimum text size in a popup

motion.$description: Component motion references (durations and easings from the lock) and the one shared transform.

press-scale.$description: The shared active transform: scale(0.98) for --motion-micro on buttons, icon buttons, filter chips, the launcher and text actions; the only transform a control animates

z.$description: Layer order (today's values kept where they exist; MUI defaults for the rest).

paper-dim.$description: Paper (PDF pages, email previews, app iframes) may be dimmed to no less than 92 % in dark mode (G5); 1 in light.

interactive.$description: A control's boundary is 1 px of --border-interactive; weight comes from colour, not thickness

underline.$description: Text actions (alert, toast, banner) and links at rest

underline-hover.$description: Text actions and links on hover and while pressed: the one text-action pattern, drawn the same everywhere

measure.$description: Reading measures (pass-through roles of the locked measures; not re-emitted).

type-weight.$description: Weight roles: the system's two weights, for state rules that change weight (a disabled tertiary label or tab drops from 600 to 400 so disabled is not told apart by hue alone).

component.$description: Tier 3. One group per listed component; each has a state group with the eight states (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, success) and, where a persistent condition exists, a named variant (selected, current, on, checked, read-only). Component tokens reference semantic tokens only.

button.$description: Buttons. One filled primary per view region (a page, a dialog, a panel; the floating layer is its own region). Labels are sentence case, --type-button 14/20 600, never multi-line (white-space: nowrap). Loading keeps width and label and appends the text dots (no spinner). Success for idempotent actions is a 2 s label swap with the check icon; for submits it is a toast. A tertiary button used as a toggle (aria-pressed) draws its pressed state as the selection tint + --selection-text + a 2 px --selection-marker bar (the tertiary pressed variant); primary and secondary buttons are never toggles. Keyboard: Tab reaches each button, Enter and Space press; a loading button stays in the tab order (aria-busy) and ignores presses.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding that lands the 20 px label at 44 / 36 with the 1 px border: the semantic control-pad-y delta

min-width.$description: A label shorter than 64 px still makes a target

org.kiwi.literal: component-specific: the minimum width of a labelled button; no other component has one

hit.$description: The hit area: the drawn height with a fine pointer, 44 px with a coarse one, through a centred pseudo-element

press-scale.$description: active: the shared press scale for --motion-micro; the only transform a button animates

marker.$description: The 2 px --selection-marker bar along the bottom edge of a pressed tertiary toggle (aria-pressed="true")

primary.$description: The one call to action: --accent-solid fill, --accent-on-solid label.

default.$description: Filled.

hover.$description: Fill steps to --accent-solid-hover, instantly.

focus.$description: :focus-visible 2 px --focus-ring at 2 px offset.

active.$description: Pressed: the fill steps past hover to --accent-solid-active (light: the system's green-black; dark: accent-12) with scale 0.98 for 150 ms, so pressed is told from hovered by fill, not by the scale alone.

Neutral text, or a status icon + label in the status's -11. Bottom-right 24/16 px measured from the safe area (bottom: calc(var(--toast-offset-y) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); bottom-left on app tabs, beside the launcher); one at a time. Timing (WCAG 2.2.1): an info or success toast without an action auto-dismisses after 6 s, and its timer pauses while the pointer is over it, while anything inside it has focus (focus-within) and while the window has lost focus; a toast that carries an action (Undo after a removal) stays until dismissed, or at least 10 s under the same pause rules; error toasts persist until dismissed. Every toast carries Dismiss; an error toast adds Retry where a retry exists; an Undo toast shows Undo beside Dismiss. Keyboard path: the toast is rendered immediately after the control that raised it, so it is the next tab stop (one Tab from the trigger reaches Undo or Dismiss, Shift+Tab returns); the live region announces the message, and an error toast (role=alert) takes focus while an info or success toast (role=status) does not; Escape dismisses the focused toast. Queue: a new info or success toast replaces a visible info or success toast that carries no action; a toast with an action and an error toast are never replaced silently: they stay until dismissed and later toasts queue behind them (first in, first out, at most three queued; identical messages collapse into one with a count).
